title: sre-weekly-update-2026-04-18
content:
SRE Weekly Update — 2026-04-18
Owner: Ava Martinez (eng-sre)
Collaborators: Danil, Priya, Liam
Status: in_review

Summary
- Light week overall. One major customer-facing incident on 2026-04-15 that triggered degraded tail-latency for hosted-api in us-west1 for ~47 minutes (INC-2026-04-15-01).
- No SLO breaches recorded for the month to date, but error budget burn increased due to the incident; we should watch the 99th percentile latency SLO for text-generation.
- On-call rotation completed handoff on 2026-04-17 without outstanding alerts.

Incidents
1) INC-2026-04-15-01 — Hosted API tail-latency spike (major)
   - Timeline (approx): 09:12 PDT spike detected by latency-alert rule -> 09:16 PagerDuty page (ops-oncall) -> mitigation started 09:20 -> full recovery 10:00 after draining a hot node pool and shifting traffic to fallback capacity.
   - Impact: Increased p99 latency for text-generation routes in us-west1; customers saw partial timeouts and retries. No data loss.
   - Root cause (investigation in progress): suspected KV cache eviction + new kernel combo for quantized model variant under heavy concurrent prefix reuse. Repro steps tracked in JIRA SRE-412.
   - Actions taken during incident: scaled up dedicated pool, triggered model-variant fallback policy, and applied temporary traffic-shaping rule to reduce concurrency for affected routes.
   - Post-incident next steps (action items):
       * SRE-412: Full repro harness to validate cache eviction under concurrent prefixes (owner: Danil, due 2026-04-25).
       * PR to add automated detection for sudden KV cache miss spikes -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/sre-tools/pull/87 (owner: Priya, in review).
       * Add recovery play to runbook: "drain-hot-node-pool-and-fallback" (owner: Liam, due 2026-04-22).

SLOs / Metrics
- Current month (Apr 2026) highlights:
   * text-gen p50/p90/p99 latency targets: 45ms / 120ms / 420ms (targets).
   * Measured (month-to-date): p50 42ms, p90 110ms, p99 390ms — within targets but close to p99 threshold after the incident.
   * Error budget: remaining 87% for the month. Incident consumed ~8% (estimate).
- Monitoring items:
   * Add alert for KV cache miss rate >= 3x baseline sustained for 5 minutes (Priya to add rule, JIRA SRE-419).
   * Need a dashboard showing model-variant fallback counts by region (helpful for ops during capacity events).

On-call handoffs / Notes
- Handoff 2026-04-17 09:00 PDT: From: Priya -> To: Danil
   * No active incidents at handoff.
   * Notes left for next oncall: watch for recurring KV cache eviction patterns and the warm-up behavior for new nodes after autoscale (documented in runbook link above).
- Upcoming on-call schedule: Danil (04/18–04/24), Liam (04/25–05/01). Please confirm swaps by Thursday EOD.

Meetings / Rituals
- Weekly SRE sync (Thurs 10:00 PT) notes:
   * Discussed progress on SRE-412 and fallback playbook.
   * Decided to prototype a lightweight prefix-aware cache simulator (spike test) to run in CI for heavy prefix workloads.
- Post-mortem meeting for INC-2026-04-15-01 scheduled 2026-04-20 11:00 PT (invite sent, Confluence doc linked in artifacts).

Work in Progress / Projects
- Autoscale smoothing tuning (owner: Liam): experimenting with 30s vs 60s scale-up cool-down to avoid oscillation. Early results: 60s reduces transient overshoot but increases recovery time; more telemetry needed.
- Model-variant fallback improvements (owner: Priya): PR in review to make fallback decision safer under concurrent prefix reuse.
- Reliability criteria for new quantized runtime kernels (owner: Danil): drafting checklist to gate kernel rollouts (expected 2026-05-05).

Blockers / Risks
- We need capacity to run the prefix-aware spike tests in CI; request to release a small gpu quota in the test project (ticket internal: INFRA-728).
- If KV cache eviction under quantized kernel combos is confirmed, we may need a rollback for the kernel rollout schedule — this risks slowing performance improvements planned for Q2.

Action Items (short)
- Danil: SRE-412 repro harness + kernel rollback plan (due 2026-04-25).
- Priya: Add KV cache-miss alert (SRE-419) and merge fallback PR (https://github.com/redwood-inference/sre-tools/pull/87) (due 2026-04-22).
- Liam: Add runbook play and update handoff checklist (due 2026-04-22).
- Ava: Request GPU quota bump for test CI (INFRA-728) and follow up with infra team.

Notes / To-self (informal)
- Need to add a short blurb to customer-status page if the postmortem finds customer-visible root cause.
- Follow up with product-ops about whether we should surface fallback counts in the customer-facing latency dashboard (might be confusing to customers).
- Keep an eye on cluster warm-up logs next week (look for steady-state after autoscale events).

Attachments / Links
- Postmortem draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SRE/INC-2026-04-15-01+postmortem
- JIRA: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/SRE-412
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sre-tools/pull/87

-- End of update
